location.subdistrict: 四川北路街道 (Sichuan North Road Sub-district)

initiators.zh: 四川北路街道社区营造团队（川造社）
initiators.en: Sichuan North Road Sub-district Community Placemaking Team

1_ice_breaking.zh: 破冰：市集嵌入式调研＋居委座谈＋商户逐户走访
1_ice_breaking.en: Ice-breaking: market-embedded research, neighbourhood-committee sessions, door-to-door merchant interviews

2_diagnosis.zh: 探索：活化诊断会＋五议题全民投票
2_diagnosis.en: Diagnosis: revitalisation clinic and ballot on five issues (management, merchants, space, footfall, positioning)

3_emergence.zh: 涌现：商户自发参与、政校企协同、针灸式业态活化
3_emergence.en: Emergence: merchant self-organisation, university–government–enterprise collaboration, acupuncture upgrades

4_integration.zh: 整合：八维度资源库＋六环节PDCA＋成套工具包
4_integration.en: Integration: eight-dimension resource library, six-step PDCA loop, toolkit

5_cultivation.zh: 培育：分层培育商业活力、共治体系、文化生长力
5_cultivation.en: Cultivation: tiered commercial development, co-governance layer, cultural vitality

working_mechanism.zh: 三师联创 + 社区营造（规划师、建筑师、评估师与街道社区营造团队融合共营）
working_mechanism.en: Three professions co-creation + community placemaking (planners, architects, appraisers with placemaking team)

name.zh: 多伦路·新生活商业活化诊断会
name.en: Duolun Road · New Life commercial revitalisation clinic

name.zh: 街区更新设计工作坊（暑期设计快闪）
name.en: Street renewal design workshop (summer design pop-up)

name.zh: 慢忆虹口、对话时光老物件展
name.en: Slow memories of Hongkou objects exhibition

name.zh: 大上海1933老物件展 AI 短视频社群分享
name.en: Greater Shanghai 1933 objects exhibition AI short-video community share

finding.zh: 被报道不等于被讨论：30多条报道、15家媒体，但阅读量仅1000多次；街区泛内容单条点赞35.8万
finding.en: Being reported is not being discussed: 30+ media items across 15+ outlets, yet verifiable reads were 1,013 across four government-portal articles; street-level content reached 358,000 likes on a single post

explanation.zh: 活动专属内容供给不足，平台讨论的是"街区"，不是"活动"
explanation.en: Activity-specific content supply was insufficient, so platforms discuss the street, not the event

finding.zh: 共识从协作中生长而非从结构中来：智力主体从商户协作中自下而上生长
finding.en: Consensus grows from collaboration, not from structure: the governing body should emerge bottom-up from merchant collaboration

explanation.zh: 在"管理之困"这个最难的问题上，投票反而呈现最强共识：治理主体应从商户协作中自下而上生长
explanation.en: On management — the issue with the least obvious answer — the ballot showed the strongest agreement
